title: rubus fruticosus var. corylifolius
intro: Rubus fruticosus var. corylifolius, commonly known as Himalayan Raspberry, is a species of raspberry that belongs to the Rosaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Himalayan Raspberry include wound healing, anti-diarrheal, and anti-cancer activities, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. The bioactive constituents present in Himalayan Raspberry, such as ellagic acid and salicylic acid, contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a valuable plant for further research in the field of pharmacology.
